Scope

This policy covers Privacy Watchdog for Android, Play edition only. It does not describe experimental Gold or iOS versions. The app provides local observations and user-directed DNS controls, not anonymity or protection against hackers.

What monitoring can see

The local VPN routes only 10.0.0.1/32 to a DNS proxy. It observes DNS/domain requests, not all traffic or total app byte volumes. Encrypted DNS, connection contents and IPv6 traffic are generally outside its visibility. A domain request or company match does not prove tracking or delivery of personal data. DNS controls can miss activity and can break services.

Permissions and notifications

Android VPN consent enables monitoring. Android's available app/UID information helps name sources; attribution can be unknown or shared. Optional Usage Access helps identify confirmed off-screen observations, not proof that a tracker fired. Monitoring works without it. Notifications are generated locally, not through cloud push.

Local processing and records

Reports and questions are processed on the device. Private app storage holds observed domains, available app/UID attribution, times, DNS request sizes, matches, screen-state evidence, summaries, notes, choices and action history. DNS sizes are not total app traffic measurements. No connection payloads are inspected by this DNS-only monitor.

Retention

Pruning runs on app opening and during monitoring, not continuously while the app is inactive. Raw DNS observations have a 30-day window; compact host history 180 days; action logs 90 days. Separate connection measurements have a 24-hour window and 20,000-row cap. Sampling attempts have a 30-day window, except the latest per app is retained. Company/app summaries, notes and saved choices remain until erased or reset as applicable.

Erase history and reset

Erase activity history removes recorded/learned history, notes and current question history, but preserves blocking choices and dismissals; unfinished tests restore prior choices. Reset everything also removes saved rules and dismissals. These controls do not promise to reset every Android permission or preference. Android Settings → Apps → Privacy Watchdog → Storage → Clear data, or uninstalling, removes private app data. Backup is disabled in the manifest; extraction rules exclude app-root data from cloud backup and device transfer.

What leaves the phone

Allowed DNS queries are sent to upstream resolvers, normally those supplied by the network, with fallback resolvers if unavailable. Other apps still contact their own services normally. Local report processing does not mean that nothing leaves the phone. We do not provide a remote VPN relay for all traffic.

Search, copy and email choices

Only after you confirm a browser search, the selected main domain is sent to DuckDuckGo via your browser; its and your browser's policies apply. Copy places the selected address on the operating-system clipboard, subject to Android's clipboard access rules. Emailing us sends your chosen message through your mail provider and to us; do not include sensitive traffic details. Feedback emails can include prefilled app/Android versions and device manufacturer/model; review before sending. Company contact actions open your mail app or the company's privacy page. Google Play handles optional ratings/reviews under its policies.

Accounts and developer collection

This Play implementation has no app account, subscription system or developer analytics backend. We do not receive or sell the app's local observation records. This does not cover information you choose to send by email or disclose through external services. Those services handle requests under their own policies.

This policy website

This static site uses GitHub Pages. Opening it sends ordinary browser-request information, such as IP address and request headers, to the hosting provider; GitHub's privacy policy applies to its processing. This is separate from local app processing. We do not promise a hosting-log retention period. The page loads no third-party scripts, fonts, analytics or translation services. Language selection is manual, with no IP, location or browser-language redirects.
